mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free rates and increases equity valuations through discounted cash flow models, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness that typically triggers monetary policy easing and fiscal stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 900) and retail sales (RSAFS < 430000) indicates weakening consumer demand that triggers negative equity market reactions due to reduced earnings expectations over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 430000.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 235) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates sustained accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 235 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 136,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 136000.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 15,790.0 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion that supports strong corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 15790.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and GDP (GDPC1 < 15800.0) indicates broad economic contraction that triggers negative equity market reactions over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 15800.0.
